products.summary: The Mac-colored version of Lofree's aluminum low-profile board. Same hardware as the Flow 2 84: 3,000 mAh battery, Bluetooth 5.3 plus a 2.4 GHz dongle, hot-swappable Surfer linear switches and VIA remapping.
products.fit: Mac typists who want an aluminum board with a macOS-default layout and the best typing feel in the low-profile class.
caveats: Only Surfer linear switches on the Mac version; the standard Flow 2 84 adds Pulse tactile and Void silent.
VIA remapping needs a JSON file from Lofree support; reviewers spent hours finding it.
The right-side touch strip can change volume when your palm brushes it; Fn + Space for 3 s disables it.
Backlight on cuts battery to roughly 13 to 21 hours in reviews.
USB-C port is on the right edge, and there is no slot to store the dongle.
